entries.message: uuid@10 and below is no longer supported.  For ESM codebases, update to uuid@latest.  For CommonJS codebases, use uuid@11 (but be aware this version will likely be deprecated in 2028).
entries.rationale: Firebase Admin's optional Cloud Storage client still selects uuid 9; forcing a semver-major transitive override would bypass the owner's compatibility contract.

entries.message: Use your platform's native DOMException instead

entries.rationale: Both current direct owners inherit node-fetch 3's deprecated DOMException shim through Google-maintained packages; Firebase Admin 14 retains it through Auth and optional Firestore paths, while the runtime uses Node 24's native DOMException where application code controls the boundary.

entries.message: Old versions of glob are not supported, and contain widely publicized security vulnerabilities, which have been fixed in the current version. Please update. Support for old versions may be purchased (at exorbitant rates) by contacting i@izs.me
entries.rationale: The current OpenTelemetry detector and Firebase Admin 14 optional Firestore client both inherit rimraf 5 and glob 10 from Google-maintained packages; overriding glob across those tool boundaries would be broader than the warning sources.

entries.message: This package is now rolled into @stellar/stellar-sdk. Please use @stellar/stellar-sdk to continue receiving updates and support.
entries.rationale: The latest Trezor Connect release owns the Stellar SDK graph; removing or overriding its internal Stellar package would bypass Trezor's tested hardware-wallet dependency set.
